# agentic-comments

Comment threads and suggestions anchored to any content, from people and agents.

Keywords: comments,threads,mentions,suggestions,annotations,collaboration,agents,yjs.

- SDK: import { Comments, Suggestions, textAnchor } from "agentic-comments". The host calls stamp(); an agent never does.
- Threads live on a Yjs document and merge across replicas.
- Events: new Notifications(comments, suggestions).subscribe(listener). Ids only, never text.
- CLI: agentic-comments <command>. MCP: agentic-comments mcp. Both use a local store file.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-comments
